a.de: Thalos arbeitet mit Workout-Logs, Mahlzeiten, Supplements, Notizen, Schlaf, Puls, HRV, aktiver Energie und — wo verfügbar — erweiterten Signalen wie CGM, Laktat, Bluttests, Mikrobiom und Performance-Assessments.
a.en: Thalos can work with workout logs, meals, supplements, notes, sleep, heart rate, HRV, active energy and — where available — advanced signals like CGM, lactate, bloodwork, microbiome and performance assessments.
